handoff.load: Load foundry-module-dev (the build protocol) and the angel-discord-bot skill.

loadByPhase.design: Load only the angel-discord-bot skill; read the private repo's plan/angel-bot-plan.md and angel-bot/design.md. No Foundry skills, no `guide start`.
loadByPhase.build: Load foundry-module-dev and the angel-discord-bot skill; `guide start`. No Foundry skills: the bot doesn't touch Foundry.
loadByPhase.live: Load foundry-module-dev and the angel-discord-bot skill. The live test is in Rhea's Discord on her PC: she runs the commands; Angel watches the text channel through computer use or her screenshots.

where: angel-bot/design.md in the private repo bcw3075/angel-mod-private (design, Rhea's decisions, status)
angel-bot/handoffs.md there (the handoffs waiting to be used)
plan/angel-bot-plan.md there (Status, Next, the build lock, open questions)
the repo's docs/changes/ (what each release did and checked)

finishList: the private repo's angel-bot/design.md: decisions and the Status line
the private repo's plan/angel-bot-plan.md: Status, Next, open questions
the private repo's angel-bot/handoffs.md: the used handoff replaced by the next one
the angel-discord-bot skill card, if a rule for the whole bot changed
the Angel Bot project's memory note angel-bot.md (a signpost: what it is, Rhea's decisions, where the status is)
the private repo's angel-bot/ copies of house-rules.md and keyterms.txt, if they changed
